AntiPattern.Bad: New `Disabled` story restates the full `args: { label, variant, size, icon, ariaLabel, ... }` map identical to `Primary.args` except for one field.
AntiPattern.WhyBad: Args restated instead of composed (`AX_SB_USE_COMPOSE_EXISTING_FIRST`). The duplicated map drifts the first time `Primary.args` gains or renames a field — the `Disabled` story silently falls behind without any test failure pointing at it.
AntiPattern.Good: `args: { ...Primary.args, disabled: true }`. Composition makes the diff visible and keeps the variant aligned with the base.
